role: Director of Web Operations and Senior Performance Engineer, Rehab LLC
dek: A Symfony application with API and HubSpot integrations, Vue and Angular in different sections, and a custom Vue patient portal.
short: Rehab.com's treatment directory: a Symfony and MySQL application with HubSpot and API integrations, Vue and Angular sections and a Vue patient portal, cut by more than 60% and moved to GitHub Actions.

items.name: AWS
items.note: Amplify, Lambda, Cognito and GraphQL on the admin platform

delivery.summary: GitHub Actions and Cloudflare Pages were introduced to replace the old workflow and deployment.

highlights.title: From the resume
highlights.text: The codebase was reduced by over 60%, monthly AWS costs by over 50%, and a single point of failure in security was removed across the web applications.

highlights.title: A sale, handed over
highlights.text: Python aggregated the data for the sale of the company, the domain and its assets, and the technical applications were transitioned to the new owners.
